class.name: SteamListingsOperation
class.brief_description: A retained observation of one Steam lobby search.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Return whether the operation has settled.

method.name: result
method.description: Return the terminal result, or null while pending.

method.name: wait
method.description: Await the same typed result before or after settlement.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Cancel local observation. The search lane remains occupied until the Steam callback drains or reaches its deadline.

signal.name: completed
signal.description: Emitted once after settling the observer.
